observer.checks: Exact genuine held policy release source member via resolve_reviewed_source_artifact; descriptor membership/selected plan dependency/current release. Only package rows in exact selected v152 profile closure, selected actual source pyproject backend/requires and target ABI/platform. Caller package_name is only selector into that finite closure, never URL/path/version/hash authority. Existing acquire-locked-runtime-packages phase authorization covers reviewed selected backend closure; fresh <=30s phase snapshot per GET, stable choice/source/setup deadline limits retained receipt lifetime without renewing old evidence.
observer.acquisition: Exact files.pythonhosted.org HTTPS wheel URLs from held table, port443, no redirects/userinfo/credential/auth headers/ambient proxy. Exact per-row size/SHA, source-specific <=1MiB compressed bytes (all eight source rows <=818216), no general downloader widening. Root-private atomic CAS, nofollow held FDs/device/inode/singlelink/current bytes checks. No installation/import or executable hook during source observation.
observer.wheel_validation: Bound archive metadata parsing to <=16MiB uncompressed and <=2048 unique regular members; reject absolute/dotdot/duplicate/symlink/hardlink/special paths. Verify canonical METADATA selected package/version/dependency/Requires-Python facts, actual RECORD hashes and all v152 license member path/SHA/size tuples. Embedded license bytes read only from held exact wheel; no external invented license receipt or declaration-only eligibility. Preserve all vendor licenses/notices, including v152 setuptools autocommand LGPL evidence. Missing/changed member/license denies.
observer.retention: Genuine root registry membership and immutable source/CAS receipt lineage. Metadata SHA observed from actual wheel; never treat table or caller hash as acquisition proof. Supporting license handle binds exact wheel/policy/source selection/member records and current root journal. No parallel signer; use existing actual source receipt journal/finite setup choice signing bridge only for intended domains.

consumer: RootApplicationBuildBackendClosureRegistry.from_root_setup replaces toolchain_source_observer parameter with backend_source_observer. It must call this actual observer before producing v152 RootApplicationBuildBackendArtifactReceipt and closure. v150 remains finite Node/Bun; runtime-lock package registry remains distinct; no backend wheel mislabeled project lock member.
